'''Terro''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] active during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was dispatched to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to locate [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] survivors of a crash, as well as put down any uprisings. He commanded a cavalry division of [[Dewback trooper/Legends|Dewback troopers]], and was particularly vicious in his pursuit.

==Behind the scenes==
Terro is a character that was introduced in ''[[Jabba's Realm]]'' and one of the Villain Packs of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
